Bug_Title: Dm: Useless/vacuous call to EasyMock method (DMI_VACUOUS_CALL_TO_EASYMOCK_METHOD)
Bug_Details: This call doesn't pass any objects to the EasyMock method, so the call doesn't do anything.
Bug_Explanation: The expectLastCall() method is called without any prior method call, making it vacuous and useless.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug() method in UselessEasyMockCall class. As the expectation of EasyMock.expectLastCall() is not set in the test, it will throw an UnexpectedMethodCallException. Since we don't catch this exception and don't add it to @Expected, the test will fail.
